Under general direction of the Manager II in the Managed Care Mointoring Branch, the Research Data Specialist III (RDS III) serves as a senior research and data expert supporting compliance monitoring required under the Managed Care Final Rule and the broader oversight of the Medi\-Cal Managed Care program. **The Opportunity**  

Tetra Tech is looking for **a full\-time, mid\-level, Responder / Environmental Scientist, Engineer** for our **Denver, CO** office. This is not a remote position.

 **Position Summary**  

The selected candidate will join a growing and energetic team supporting environmental projects in the Rocky Mountain region of the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be involved in all facets of environmental management.

 **Essential Job Functions (Required)**  

The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions:

* Support and lead field work for Federal and Private clients, including project management, budgeting, and scheduling.
* Provide technical support to a long\-term U.S. Environmental Protection Agency contract in the areas of site investigation, Brownfields redevelopment, removal assessment, data management, and emergency response.
* Work includes a broad range of site types from abandoned properties to mine sites, to industrial/commercial facilities, orphaned wells, to spills \- with work locations across Colorado, Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota, Utah, and Wyoming.
* Oversee and conduct multi\-media sampling, field audits and inspections, use of a range of field monitoring equipment, organizing and reviewing data, preparing reports and maps, file reviews, collection of air monitoring data, training and exercise support, contractor oversight, task and project management, and related services.
* Lead a field team, including leading health and safety activities, sampling, and data collection and reporting.
* Perform tasks across multiple disciplines to bring about successful project completion
* Demonstrate full knowledge of each project’s status and goals
* Emergency response work includes mobilizing to spill or response sites and work with EPA and other parties to support air monitoring, sampling, communications support, and data management.
* Understand and use of environmental monitoring equipment
* Work in Levels A, B, C and D PPE

 **Why Tetra Tech**  

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

* B.S./B.A. in Geology, Chemistry, Engineering, Biology, Geography or other related environmental science
* Years of Experience: 7\+ years
* The position requires periodic on\-call support, up to two weeks per month. The ability to respond quickly, within a mandatory response time, is required.
* Ability to travel, including overnight and weekends.
* Demonstrated ability to organize, coordinate, analyze, and present technical material.
* Excellent writing skills that include the ability to read and assimilate technical and scientific information.
* Ability to learn quickly and multi\-task.
* Highly motivated, customer focused
* Work well in a team environment.
* Ability to work independently and under direct on\-site supervision.
* Ability to manage a heavy workload
* Excellent communication, client interaction, and organizational skills.
* Strong educational and work foundation
* Ability to wear Level D\-B PPE

In addition, the following is required:  

* Background check
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 40\-hour OSHA HAWOPER training
* Completion of ICS 100, 200, 700, and 800 training
* Asbestos and lead certification


You will preferably have experience with some or all of the following:  

* Hydrogeological investigations
* Hazardous materials surveys (including asbestos, lead\-based paint)
* Analytical data using spreadsheets and databases
* Conceptual remedial action plans and remedial cost estimates
* Phase I ESAs to ASTM or higher standards
* Phase II ESAs
* Mastery with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access) is strongly desired.
* Fluency in Spanish (spoken and written) is preferred but not required.
 **Work Environment/Environmental Factors (Required)**


This position requires up to 70% travel to support environmental emergency response situations throughout the Mountain Region, on short notice, where the applicant will be a part of field teams and provide technical support to EPA personnel at a range of site investigation and response sites.


You must be able to mobilize for emergency response efforts from our warehouse in Arvada, CO within 2 hours when you are on\-call. Periodic on\-call support is up to two weeks per month. The ability to respond quickly, within a mandatory response time, is required.

 **Physical Requirements (Required)**  

The physical demands described here represent those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made.  

* Walk on uneven terrain
* Lift and carrying objects up to 50 lbs.
* Wear and work in an air purifying respirator and self\-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA).
* Work periodic long days, including 12\+ hours, especially when in the field, including evenings and weekends.
* Work outside in all weather conditions, both hot and cold and inclement weather
* Work around or with chemical and biological hazards.
* Drive on a regular basis.
* Passing a motor vehicle record b

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Sunnyvale / Lafayette
  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time
  

**Reports to:** Senior Environmental Engineer or Geologist/Project Manager


**Company Overview**
  

Cornerstone Earth Group is a leading Bay Area environmental and geotechnical consulting firm committed to providing innovative solutions for a range of challenges faced by our clients. We specialize in site assessments, remediation, mitigation, and compliance services for a diverse portfolio of clients including Big Tech, residential and commercial development, universities, and municipal sectors. We are seeking a motivated and adaptable Environmental Staff Geologist/Engineer to join our dynamic team.


**Job Summary**
  

We are looking for an entry to mid\-level Environmental Staff Geologist/Engineer to support our growing projects. The ideal candidate will play a key role in conducting site observations, sample collection, and coordinating with subcontractors. This position offers the opportunity to gain valuable hands\-on experience in environmental consulting, working alongside senior professionals in the field. The successful candidate will also assist with project documentation, cost estimates, proposals, and technical correspondence.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Conduct site observations and environmental assessments.
* Collect soil, groundwater, soil vapor, and ambient air, and other environmental samples in accordance with project requirements, regulatory guidance, and quality assurance protocols.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors to ensure timely completion of tasks and adherence to project specifications and budgets.
* Assist in the preparation of cost estimates, proposals, and technical reports for environmental projects.
* Help prepare and review technical correspondence with clients, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with Cornerstone Earth Group’s Project Managers and Principals to support project execution and troubleshooting.
* Develop a strong understanding of environmental regulations and industry best practices.
* Ensure proper documentation of field activities (including chain of custody documentation), sample analysis, and project data.
* Prepare data summary tables and figure drafting.
* Adapt to changing project requirements and assist in troubleshooting on\-site issues.
* Prepare plans and specifications for remediation and mitigation strategies.
* Assist with other environmental engineering tasks as needed.

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geology, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* 0–3 years of relevant work experience in environmental consulting, geotechnical, or related fields. (Internships or related coursework can be considered for entry\-level candidates.)
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively collaborate with colleagues, clients, and subcontractors.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced but supportive environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and other common office software.
* Willingness to work outdoors in various weather conditions and limited travel as needed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to be adaptable, self\-motivated, and proactive in problem\-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Professional certification (e.g., E.I.T, G.I.T) or ability to obtain certification within a reasonable timeframe.
* Experience with environmental sampling, site assessments, and regulatory compliance (e.g., ASTM, EPA, state/local regulations).
* Familiarity with environmental software tools (e.g., AutoCAD, GIS).
* Knowledge of cost estimation and proposal preparation.

**Why Join Us**


* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Exposure to a wide variety of interesting and impactful environmental projects.

If you are a highly motivated, adaptable individual looking to contribute to meaningful environmental work, we encourage you to apply.


**Compensation: $68,000 to $90,000, depending on experience.**


**To Apply:** Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant work samples or portfolio to careers@cornerstoneearth.com


Cornerstone Earth Group is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
